prerequisites: Knowledge from the module "Programmierung 1 E/Me" of the first semester is required.

learning_outcomes.text: Students have knowledge of the essential methods of object-oriented programming.
Students are able to apply object-oriented methods in program implementation.
They possess the ability to structure concrete problems with object-oriented language elements and implement them in programs.
This includes the ability to identify and fix errors.
Students are able to describe object-oriented programs with the appropriate technical vocabulary.
They can explain the structure of these programs.
Students can analyze and structure problems from the field of electrical engineering and implement them in corresponding object-oriented programs.

assessment_rules: The graded assessment is a written exam or e-exam, as specified in the applicable study regulations. The ungraded assessment is an experimental work consisting of approximately 10 experiments. The exact duration and scope for the written exam/e-exam are as per the valid study regulations.
